name: Equatorial Guinea (1973–1979)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, white and red with a blue triangle at the hoist, and the emblem of the Macías Nguema regime, a cockerel above tools and weapons, in the centre.
history: During the dictatorship of Francisco Macías Nguema the coat of arms, and with it the national flag, were changed to a new emblem with a cockerel, tools and weapons, adopted in 1973 and in use until Macías was overthrown by his nephew Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo on 21 August 1979, when the 1968 arms with the silk-cotton tree were restored.

features.role: emblem of the Macías Nguema regime with a cockerel
